description: Is this Solana token safe to hold or receive? A safe, warn or danger verdict. When to use: Before accepting or swapping into an unfamiliar token, to see whether its mint can freeze, mint more, move or tax balances. Prefer another tool: Not a price, liquidity or holder lookup and not an audit of the token's project; it reads only the mint account. Example: solana_token {"mint":"EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v"}

mint.description: Mint address of an SPL Token or Token-2022 token (base58, 32 bytes)

name: solana_token

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time

as_of.description: When we read the data from Solana (our read time)

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Lowest context slot of the finalized reads behind the answer; null when none of them carries one, never 0

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

default_account_state.description: DefaultAccountState of new token accounts of the mint (`frozen`: they start frozen); null without DefaultAccountState

extensions.description: Token-2022 mint extensions by name; empty for SPL Token

freeze_authority.description: Null when the freeze authority is renounced

interest_rate_pct.description: InterestBearingConfig current rate in percent, an annual rate compounded continuously (its basis points / 100, exact; negative for a negative rate; display only); null without that extension

metadata_address.description: MetadataPointer address, where the token metadata lives (only named here, never read); null when unset, without MetadataPointer, or when its value is not 64 bytes (unreadable)

mint_authority.description: Null when the mint authority is renounced

mint_close_authority.description: MintCloseAuthority, which can close the mint once its supply is zero; null when unset or without MintCloseAuthority

paused.description: Pausable paused flag (true: transfers are paused); null without Pausable

permanent_delegate.description: PermanentDelegate, which can transfer or burn tokens from any account of the mint; null when unset or without PermanentDelegate

reasons.description: Every matched code of every level; empty for safe

supply.description: Total supply in display units of the mint (`supply_atomic` / 10^`decimals`, exact); not adjusted by a ScaledUiAmount multiplier or an interest rate

supply_atomic.description: Total supply in base units of the mint (raw), exact

token_program.description: SPL Token or Token-2022 program address

transfer_fee_authority.description: TransferFeeConfig authority, which can change the fee; null when unset or without a TransferFeeConfig

transfer_fee_max.description: Maximum fee per transfer of the active fee, in display units of the mint (raw / 10^decimals, exact); null without a TransferFeeConfig

epoch.description: Epoch from which the newer fee applies

transfer_fee_max.description: Newer maximum fee per transfer in display units of the mint (raw / 10^decimals, exact)

transfer_fee_pct.description: Newer transfer fee in percent (basis points / 100)

transfer_fee_next.description: TransferFeeConfig newer fee while its epoch is after the current epoch (from that epoch on it is the active fee); null otherwise or without a TransferFeeConfig

transfer_fee_pct.description: Transfer fee active at the current epoch, in percent (basis points / 100); null without a TransferFeeConfig

transfer_hook_program_id.description: TransferHook program that each transfer of the mint invokes; null when unset or without TransferHook

ui_multiplier.description: ScaledUiAmount multiplier in effect at response time, the factor a wallet applies to the display amount, as a plain decimal string (display only, never used in amount math); null without ScaledUiAmount

ui_multiplier_next.description: ScaledUiAmount new multiplier while its effective time (`ui_multiplier_next_at`) is after the response time (from that time on it is `ui_multiplier`); null otherwise, without ScaledUiAmount, or when the new multiplier is not a finite number (its effective time is still served)

ui_multiplier_next_at.description: Effective time of the scheduled ScaledUiAmount multiplier change; null when no change is scheduled after the response time, without ScaledUiAmount, or when that time cannot be rendered as an RFC 3339 date-time; served even when `ui_multiplier_next` is null because the new multiplier is not a finite number

verdict.description: Highest level matched: danger > warn > safe

title: Solana token verdict
